source_location: Printed page 7, Example of calculations using the CFS PUMS
shipment_domain: ORIG_STATE = 24 (all Maryland-origin shipments in CFS-covered establishments, all destinations, all modes)
weighting_rule: Weighted sum of SHIPMT_VALUE * WGT_FACTOR across every CFS PUMS shipment in origin-state-24 domain
variance_rule: Census GVF: exp(a+b*ln(n)+c*(ln(n))^2) gives CV as a PERCENT; coefficient n is PUMS domain record count
